title: Session 3 · Checking longer strings
description: Practice checking from left to right, then compare exact matching on fresh six- and eight-character strings with the same gentle timer.
instructions: 25 minutes maximum. Objective 2 min, Character preview and unscored demo 4 min, rounds up to 15 min, debrief 4 min. Confirm the characters look clear on the learner device. On a separate unscored example, show how to check from left to right in small chunks. Complete the six-character round first, then the eight-character round. Each round allows 30 seconds per item. Let the learner work independently without hints during scored items. Ask: Where did you start checking, and what did you do next? Record any help, interruptions or display issues. Stop if uncomfortable.
